_doc: Rung-4 animation fixtures (docs/pc-test-rig.md): each names blueprints to stage and the expected distinct-state band [min,max] PER APP over a 12-frame jittered burst. Bands are MEASURED (2026-08-05 first baseline) except where noted aspirational: a band the Raves side currently fails documents the porting target. `checker.py anim <fixture>` measures; classes: static(1) / discrete / continuous(>=75% frames unique).

warm-static.notes: MEASURED AGREE: qud 4 / raves 3-4 discrete. The recurring pixel-pass WARN/FAILs are pure phase mismatch — the animation itself is congruent. Candidate for anim-aware banding in the scored sweep.

machine-tubing.notes: ASPIRATIONAL: qud 11 continuous, raves 1 STATIC — Raves does not animate the coolant tubing at all. Renderer gap; the walls-category WARNs are this.

phasic-screw.notes: ASPIRATIONAL: qud 5 discrete (phase bands), raves 1 STATIC — no phase flicker ported. Renderer gap.

switch-blink.notes: MEASURED AGREE at 1/1: an UNPOWERED switch does not blink. The furniture pixel FAILs for Switch are therefore a STATIC art difference, not animation — re-triage against the evidence crops (findings section 6 revised).

campfire.notes: MEASURED AGREE: qud 11 / raves 12 continuous. The sanity case.
